verdict.rationale: Perplexity ships its own hosted agents that can be handed tasks. Agent API presets give 'a working agent in one field' with built-in web search, URL fetch and a code sandbox. The Computer MCP server lets clients 'delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.' However, this is delegation through API and MCP calls rather than an assistant embedded inside the product's own interface; the only interactive surface shown is a search Playground. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant UI for delegating tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated multi-step task execution.
